title: Herbal Soap Selling Price Calculator
problem: Women making handmade neem soaps sell them at very low prices, losing money on expensive coconut oil and raw materials.
idea: A fair price calculator. The soap maker types what she spent on one batch, and it tells her the cost of one soap and a fair selling price with profit.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Fair Price for One Neem Soap
widgets.intro: Type the money spent for ONE batch. These are sample numbers – change them to your real costs.

inputs.label: Her own work time (₹) – don't forget this!

widgets.formula: var all = [oil, lye, neem, pack, labour, soaps, profit]; if (all.some(function(x){return typeof x !== 'number' || x < 0;}) || soaps < 1) return null; var total = oil + lye + neem + pack + labour; var cost = total / soaps; var price = Math.ceil(cost * (1 + profit / 100)); var earn = price * soaps - total; return {total: total, cost: Math.round(cost * 10) / 10, price: price, earn: Math.round(earn), level: profit >= 15 ? 'good' : 'warn'};

items.title: Count your time
items.text: Your work hours have value. Add them to the cost.
items.te: మీ పని సమయానికీ విలువ ఉంది. ఖర్చులో కలపండి.

items.title: Stay safe
items.text: Soap chemicals can burn skin. Always wear gloves and keep children away.
items.te: సబ్బు రసాయనాలు చర్మాన్ని కాల్చగలవు. గ్లవ్స్ వేసుకోండి, పిల్లలను దూరంగా ఉంచండి.

items.title: Nice packing
items.text: A neat paper wrap and label helps you sell at a fair price.
items.te: చక్కని ప్యాకింగ్, లేబుల్ ఉంటే మంచి ధరకు అమ్మవచ్చు.

items.title: Write every cost
items.text: Keep a small notebook of all expenses for each batch.
items.te: ప్రతి బ్యాచ్ ఖర్చులు ఒక నోట్‌బుక్‌లో రాయండి.

how: Ask the soap-making aunties to tell me every cost for one batch, including their time.
Open Scratch and make variables for each cost, number of soaps and profit %.
Use 'ask and wait' blocks so the maker can type the numbers.
Add all costs, divide by the number of soaps to get cost per soap.
Multiply by (1 + profit ÷ 100) and make the sprite say the fair price.
Ask Gemini for simple selling tips and test the tool with real numbers.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student helping village women who make neem soap. Explain in simple steps how to calculate the cost of one soap and a fair selling price with 25% profit, including the value of their own work time. Use simple English and Telugu with one example.
